selected_skill.purpose: Guide the agent to turn a fixed contract, wireframes, and public data snapshots into a single-file browser briefing site with contract-complete pages, embedded charts, and local-file playback.
selected_skill.naming_note: This template binds the shipped task-local skill directory `single-file-briefing-deck` under environment/skills. The without-skill comparison removes only that directory during runtime copy.
key_workflow_points: read the page contract before editing code
track page completion against required page ids, modules, and chart ids
derive shared metric years from the bundled data instead of guessing them
keep the deck in one HTML file plus one manifest file
audit navigation and viewport fit in a browser before handoff

environment_design.determinism: The task uses fixed public-data snapshots, fixed wireframes, and a fixed page contract. Verifier-side checks recompute expected metrics from the local snapshots, inspect the generated HTML structure, and replay viewport checks instead of trusting filenames or summaries alone.
environment_design.with_without_rule: The with-skill and without-skill variants may differ only by the presence or absence of environment/skills and the established runtime copy logic that removes that directory for the without-skill run. Instruction, tests, data, dependencies, and the skill contents themselves must stay identical across the comparison.
anti_toy_features: multiple public-source datasets in mixed formats with different metric vintages
contract-defined page order plus wireframe-defined layout expectations, so page completion requires more than filling text slots
required chart, table, and explanatory-text colocation on the same page sections
single-file HTML delivery with local-file playback, navigation behavior, and viewport constraints
manifest cross-checks against page ids, chart ids, module ids, and metric years
formal local build entrypoint that must remain reusable on alternate fixtures

main_tests: formal build entrypoint produces the required HTML site and manifest
required page ids, page order, module coverage, and chart coverage match the contract
computed metrics and captions match the bundled data snapshots
wireframe-sensitive structure checks confirm that required sections appear on the intended pages
viewport-fit and navigation checks run across all required pages instead of stopping at the first pass
manifest and HTML stay consistent on page ids, chart ids, embedded assets, and metric years
guardrails: the shipped input area remains unchanged
top-level output inventory exactly matches the contract
placeholder-oriented or verifier-oriented text in the formal outputs fails

expected_skill_effect.without_skill: Without the bundled skill, agents are more likely to drift into building a generic webpage, miss the contract-to-wireframe mapping, skip viewport and navigation auditing, or stop after partial page assembly. Those are action-level or analysis-level misses rather than narrow formatting misses.
expected_skill_effect.with_skill: The bundled skill can provide a compact workflow for contract reading, page-by-page module tracking, local-file browser verification, and final manifest alignment, which should materially improve completion odds without changing the task statement or test surface.
